steps.note: R32 (blind run A fixes): HaX gives the fight controls as the briefing closes, before Hollis can see the player. Every choice that starts a fight is marked '(Fight him.)' and warned in narration (Hollis, Park, Mercer); Park's way out is marked, and on the second visit says there won't be another. Hollis's in-fight texts add only what the early text didn't. The hands-down text comes once, on the first KO. The SCADA keypad's case hint (after a near miss only, since the post-engine follow-ups), the flag-3 'window just shut' text, the 'I'm stuck' line, Hollis's bluff reply and Elena's desk-summary choice.

said: The checkpoint guard is bought. If anyone swings at you: Q for fists, E or click to punch, face them squarely. Q until the open hand shows to use anything.
Nice try. Keep your hands where I can see them.
One more push and this turns into a fight.
[choice] Put it down. (Fight him.)
[choice] I'm stepping back.
He comes off the frame at you with his fists up. This is going to be a fight.
Fists up, face him, hit him. Q a second time throws the harder punch.
He's slower than you, and he won't leave the checkpoint. If it's going badly, walk out of his reach.
notSaid: Keep pressing Q until the open hand shows

said: Hollis is down
Hands down: press Q until the open hand shows. While your fists are up, nothing you click will open.
Tell me where.
[choice] I'm on the Kali box. Where do I start on their host?
[choice] The desk summary says ninety days dormant. No deaths projected.
notSaid: Dormant ninety days. No projected fatalities. That's our brief.

said: Right word, wrong case. Capital C, capital W.
[choice] Then finish it and see what happens. (Fight him.)
[choice] Nothing. I was never here. (Back off.)
Second time. There isn't a third.
[choice] Nothing. I was never here. (Back off. Next time he swings.)
I said there wasn't a third.
crimping tool swinging. This is going to be a fight.
Park's swinging.
[choice] Away from the console, or I put you on the floor. (Fight him.)
comes towards you anyway. This is going to be a fight.
Mercer's coming at you.
The window to move the team just shut.
notSaid: The team stays where it is now.
